column1: # Edit this file to tell the dashboard how fast you train each skill; it powers
# the time estimates for "next level" and the next milestone (99/110/120/200m).
#   - exp_per_hour: average XP per hour as a number; commas are stripped
#   - training_method: shown in the UI; quote it if it contains a comma
# Entries not listed (or with exp_per_hour 0) simply show "no estimate".
# Changes are picked up automatically - no restart needed.
